description: This file defines the 'Conditional' class within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library, containing static methods for performing conditional statistical computations such as AVERAGEIF, COUNTIF, MAXIFS, SUMIF, etc., primarily for spreadsheet data analysis.

classes.name: Conditional
classes.description: A class providing static methods for conditional statistical functions such as AVERAGEIF, COUNTIF, SUMIF, and their variants, operating on ranges of spreadsheet data.

methods.name: AVERAGEIF
methods.description: Calculates the average of cells that meet a specific condition within a range.

methods.name: AVERAGEIFS
methods.description: Calculates the average of cells that meet multiple criteria.

methods.name: COUNTIF
methods.description: Counts the number of cells that meet a specific condition within a range.

methods.name: COUNTIFS
methods.description: Counts the number of cells that meet multiple criteria.

methods.name: MAXIFS
methods.description: Returns the maximum value within a range that meets specified criteria.

methods.name: MINIFS
methods.description: Returns the minimum value within a range that meets specified criteria.

methods.name: SUMIF
methods.description: Sums the values of cells that meet a specific condition.

methods.name: SUMIFS
methods.description: Sums the values of cells that meet multiple criteria.
